messages:
Annie: quick question — if a user pins a model in the route inspector and then saves that route view, should the pin be persisted in the saved query or only kept as a transient UI state? I think both behaviours have tradeoffs.
Matt: my vote is persist. reopening saved view should restore the exact filter + pin state. Otherwise users get confused when compare pockets don't match.
Kevin: caution: persisting pins means savedquery needs to store model id + variant + quantization metadata. That interacts poorly with rollouts where a variant might be phased out.
Sofia: telemetry note: if saved view enforces pinned model on the UI but the backend routes to a different model at runtime (policy fallback), our telemetry and cost previews will diverge. We need a clear 'effective_model' event.
Darren: ux idea: save the pin but surface a small badge: "Pinned model: m-13b-v2" and a toggle "Respect runtime routing policies" (on by default). When off, console adds a note: "Requests may be routed differently in production."
Matt: also we should show cost preview at save-time using the pinned model. If the model later becomes unavailable, saved view should show a warning and fallback options.
Kevin: backend implications: suggest adding saved_view.pinned_models: [{"model_id":"m-13b-v2","commit":"a1b2"}] and a saved_view.pin_policy enum {APPLY_IF_AVAILABLE, SNAPSHOT_ONLY}. APPLY_IF_AVAILABLE tries to route to pinned model; SNAPSHOT_ONLY just stores metadata for restore UI.
Annie: that enum seems useful. product decision TBD: default should be APPLY_IF_AVAILABLE for power users, SNAPSHOT_ONLY as an advanced opt-in.
Sofia: telemetry event: saved_view.opened should include fields: restored_pin, resolved_model, routed_model, cost_estimate. That helps us catch divergences.
Kevin: PR ready to add the DB column and event fields — CI bot attached.
ci-bot: deploy: console-backend -> add saved_view.pinned_models (PR #4321). staging rollout scheduled tomorrow 03:00 UTC :rocket:
Darren: I'll mock the badge + toggle. Can we get a sample API shape from kevin so I can wire the toggle state? 
Kevin: sending stub: POST /api/saved_views { "id":..., "pinned_models":[{"model_id":"m-13b-v2","policy":"APPLY_IF_AVAILABLE"}]} — testing now.
Annie: ok let's treat this as a mini-rollout. who wants to own QA telemetry anomalies when this lands?
Sofia: I'll take initial checks, run a quick sweep of saved_view.opened vs request.effective_model for a day after rollout.
Annie: perfect — thanks team. We'll reconvene after staging smoke.
